### Decisions (also recorded in the manifest's Round-11 decomposition decisions)

- **Ids as they stand; filename rule `<row>_<id>__<slug>.md`** (the Round-10 sequence-prefix convention): lexical order = chain order, which the legacy `P34.1__<slug>.md` form would break (`P34.10` before `P34.2`; `P35.38a` at row 203). Five ids are outside the canonical id grammar (`PLAN-11B/C/D`, `GATE-ACCEPT-R11`, `GATE-ANNOUNCE`) and are accepted as listed chain rows (legacy-filename rule); kept unchanged because the seed ADRs, §56 owners and the LEDGER cite them. Slugs are hand-set in `gen_t3.py` `SLUG` and now bind to their ids.
- **Banners:** the five sub-round banners named in the unit prompt, each split after an acquisition wave's activation row inside it (271 Wave A, 290 Wave B, 345 Wave C, 481 Wave D) — nine banners, so the per-wave digest ("after the last row under a chain-table banner"; A-15 "Gate pauses + wave digest (Recommended)", 2026-10-01T04:21:56Z) has a boundary at each wave (≈ 8–10 wave digests in plan §11.2). The 290 boundary is also the GATE-G4b position if PLAN-11B's sizing review fires the re-split rule.
- **Gate cell = short form** (pause class, OM-20 status, GATE-P answer lines); the plan's full gate text is in each skeleton's `Gate status` header. Round-11 rows avoid the words the validator's lowest-unlanded `nextTicket` rule treats as skip markers (superseded / deferred / unused / skipped / withdrawn / dropped — a case-insensitive substring match over the whole row): rows 205/207/232/510 would otherwise have been skipped through their gate text, and P34.32's scope cell reads "supersession status lines" for its title's "superseded status".
- **Kind `plan`** kept for PLAN-11B/C/D (outside the template's kind list; a contract-authoring row run like a ticket).
- **Requirement ids:** spec §56 `Owner:` / `Also:` lines (final ids) + ids named by the plan row / catalog (draft ids mapped by `stageB/T1_id_map.csv`; only ids defined in `spec_src` kept; "SIG-CONTRIB-030a" read as SIG-INGEST-030a) + carry ids. 91 of 310 rows name at least one id; §56: 62 ids, 58 owned by chain rows (each appears as `Owner` in its row's skeleton), 4 by seed units (SIG-MEM-005, SIG-MEM-012, SIG-ENG-041, SIG-ENG-044). TRANSP / K13 drafts named in a row are listed as later-family drafts (PLAN-11B / PLAN-11C).
- **Carry items placed:** P34.16 ("the operator's own determination (no counsel)", TS-09; WV-01 vs C-5), P34.17 and P36.64 (WV-01 vs C-5 "Omit until I write it", 2026-10-01T04:56:11Z), P34.8 (CF-03 queue path; MIGRATION.md L55–57 date corrections), P34.22a (`p-17b713` pin parametrised), P35.34 (SIG-INGEST-004 binding versions — MUST stands), P35.14a (SIG-ONTO-060 enum read + proposal; agent assignment, labelled), P36.77 and GATE-ANNOUNCE (outreach ids on the unmet list), PLAN-11B (SIG-TRANSP prefix in §0.3; owners SIG-SEC-008 → P35.1a/b, SIG-SEC-009 → P35.4, SIG-CONF-010 → P35.60; GATE-G4b rule), PLAN-11C (K13 prefixes; SIG-OPS-007 → P35.2).
